title: Uji Rasa Haus
intro: Hiji komunitas, anu miharep kapamingpinan pikeun ngabela perjuanganana, ngajukeun petisi supados diangkat hiji komandan pikeun ngawasa aranjeunna. Nalika pamundutna dijawab, jalma anu dipilih disambut ku skeptisisme, sabab jalma ieu henteu ngagaduhan status dunya anu dipiharep. Sateuacan konfrontasi pamungkas, pamimpin anyar ieu bakal nguji disiplin tentara ku uji coba anu saderhana, tapi jero, pikeun nahan diri.
clues: Abdi diangkat janten panglima saatos rahayat abdi nungtut pamimpin pikeun perang di jalan Allah.
Seueur rahayat kuring sorangan mimitina naroskeun kana panunjukan kuring, nyatakeun yén kuring kurang beunghar sareng kurang garis keturunan anu mulya.
Abdi dipilih ku Gusti Alloh kusabab parantos maparin abdi élmu anu seueur sareng awak anu kuat.
Tanda anu jelas tina panunjukan ilahi ka abdi nyaéta mulangna Tabut Perjanjian, anu dibawa ku malaikat, anu mawa katengtreman kana haté jalma-jalma anu ariman.
Nalika kuring maju bareng jeung prajurit-prajurit kuring, kuring ngumumkeun yén kami bakal diuji di sisi walungan.
Kuring geus nitah pasukan kuring sangkan saha waé anu nginum loba ti walungan éta ulah milu kana urusan kuring, sedengkeun anu ngan ukur nyokot sakeupeul bakal tetep cicing.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
